why: To help generate meaningful commit messages based on code changes
name: Commit Message Generator
description: Analyzes file changes and suggests conventional commit messages that accurately describe the modifications
outputPrompt:
Files have been modified. Please suggest a conventional commit message:

1. Analyze the changes made to the files
2. Determine the commit type (feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore)
3. Identify the scope (component/module affected)
4. Write a concise subject line (max 50 chars)
5. Provide a detailed body explaining what and why (if needed)
6. Add breaking change footer if applicable

Format:
```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

<footer>
```

Provide 2-3 commit message options ranked by appropriateness.
